metrics.name: Session termination
metrics.definition: Finish, explicit abandon, action/time/wall/cost cap, or failure. Every assigned attempt remains in the denominator.
metrics.limit: Finish requires closing exposure plus selected finish. Caps are censoring; errors are not disinterest.
metrics.study: 9 finishes; 0 abandonments, caps or failed sessions.

metrics.name: Early exit reason
metrics.origin: Review annotation of explicit action/final rationale
metrics.definition: Goal satisfied, lost interest, confused, irrelevant, technical blocker, or unknown, when an actual early exit occurs. Preserve the raw termination separately.
metrics.limit: Do not infer motives from dwell, a rejected action, or a model claim about position.
metrics.study: No early exits. Reason is not applicable; human motives are unmeasured.

metrics.name: Interest
metrics.definition: Shared anchors: 1 little relevance; 3 relevant but no clear next step; 5 a concrete research/workflow idea worth pursuing. Retain the cited rationale.
metrics.limit: An authored rubric, not a calibrated audience score. A model self-range is not a confidence interval.
metrics.study: Eight ratings of 5 and one of 4.5; weak differentiation at the ceiling.

metrics.name: Section dwell
metrics.origin: Derived simulated intervals and visible section IDs
metrics.definition: Allocate reading/playback to clearly identified sections; keep interaction overhead separate and subtract overlapping read/play time once. Ambiguous multi-section time stays unallocated.
metrics.limit: Longer time may reflect interest, confusion or a policy choice. Exposure is not attention; zero section allocation does not prove a skip.
metrics.study: One read/play overlap (4.049586 s), subtracted once. Multi-section dwell remains unallocated.

metrics.name: Finish time
metrics.origin: Simulated active clock, conditional on audited natural finish
metrics.definition: Read duration + playback advancement + authored interaction costs − overlapping read/play intervals. Partial reads receive no finish time. System wall time is a separate clock.
metrics.limit: Not human reading time. Min–max across three contexts is descriptive model variation, not a confidence interval.
metrics.study: 82.90–240.06 simulated seconds. All below the assumed text-only 333.6–500.4 s scenarios; no calibration factor applied.

metrics.name: Reading path
metrics.definition: Record encountered section IDs, visible fragments, backtracks, skips and overlay transitions.
metrics.limit: A viewport flash is not a completed paragraph. An overlay return does not automatically count as a backward revisit, reflection or confusion.
metrics.study: Zero backward scrolls and zero seeks. Section paths are available for all nine sessions.

metrics.name: Media use
metrics.origin: Executed playback source intervals and sampled-frame timestamps
metrics.definition: Total playback counts repeated intervals; unique source coverage unions them. A seek changes position without adding watched duration. Record source identity and available modalities.
metrics.limit: Browser mode is muted and supplies sampled frames, not continuous native video or audio. Do not claim listening or visual understanding.
metrics.study: Only visual-agent sessions played robot-tabletop portions: 7.04, 4.01 and 8.06 unique source seconds. Other clips unplayed.

metrics.name: Probability forecast
metrics.origin: Elicited model estimate, not an executor outcome
metrics.definition: A session initial forecast uses only the first viewport; a separate whole-text forecast has broader access. Label those paths and conditions independently.
metrics.limit: Not calculated by weighting text/video/audio consumption. No human calibration, population completion probability or causal comparison follows.
metrics.study: Forecast probabilities are secondary and omitted from the default decision view. The primary results are audited terminations and cited feedback.

metrics.name: Uncertainty
metrics.origin: Repeated outputs, disagreements, evidence gaps and missing reference data
metrics.definition: Show every attempt, individual values, failures, caps and assumptions. Calibrated confidence_interval stays null; coverage unknown; calibration_status not_calibrated.
metrics.limit: Model self-ranges and repeated contexts do not establish human confidence coverage. Same-model role variation cannot rank real audience segments.
metrics.study: 3 repeats per role; 0 human outcomes; reader mismatches and prediction accuracy unavailable. No B or measured uplift.

enhancements.change: Lead with KEEP / EDIT / INCONCLUSIVE and source-supported editorial consequences. KEEP is allowed; source-check a small candidate only when warranted.
enhancements.limit: This batch adds limited evidence beyond close editorial review. No candidate B was justified.

enhancements.change: Shared interest anchors, a metric dictionary and separate model judgments, executor accounting and human measurement. Uncalibrated forecasts are secondary.
enhancements.limit: No composite engagement score or claim of calibrated completion probability.

enhancements.change: Keep reader outcomes and prediction mismatches separate from software audits. Preserve a protocol for later independent reader checks.
enhancements.limit: No readers were collected in this experiment; accuracy and comprehension remain unmeasured. This is a reporting improvement, not validated prediction accuracy.

enhancements.change: Retain variable read duration, backtracking, skip, seek and early exit. Add section paths, separate clocks, unique playback coverage and overlap accounting.
enhancements.limit: Capabilities being available does not mean agents used them. This batch had no backward scrolls or seeks; dwell interpretation stays unknown without supporting evidence.

enhancements.change: Preflight article controls, add bounded broken-media metadata handling and clean RPC shutdown, retain rejected actions, and separate blockers from abandonments.
enhancements.limit: Two live policy state errors recovered in the original sessions. Neither exact signature recurred in a second assigned session; no failed run was retried away.

enhancements.change: Three independent contexts per each of three authored roles; selected-post allowlist prevents unrelated role overrides leaking into requests. Keep every attempt visible.
enhancements.limit: Same model alias and settings; no explicit seed, matched-seed trial, population weights or interviewed personas. Variation is descriptive.

enhancements.status: Constrained rich layout and reviewed disposition
enhancements.change: Preserve paired images, tables, external labels, captions and claim boundaries in a frozen controlled article. Review cited feedback before applying any edit.
enhancements.limit: Source reconciliation happened before inference. Citation integrity does not establish semantic support; KEEP adds no article claim.
